info.name: Earth API — Launch Preview
info.description: Importable request templates for the Earth API launch preview. Maintained by the Earth API operator with AI assistance. The collection uses only https://api.earth.icu/v1. At the latest public check, the Models & pricing route remained on its loading state and exposed no model or rate rows. Verify account access, the authenticated catalog, and current pricing before testing. Do not store production keys, private prompts, personal data, or billing details in a shared collection. No request runs automatically.

request.description: Returns the model catalog available to the authenticated account. This does not submit a generation request and does not prove that the account has sufficient balance or that every returned model is ready for production use.

exec: throw new Error('Generation is disabled. Review pricing and availability, then set collection variable runGeneration to YES.');
throw new Error('Choose a model returned by the current model catalog and set the collection variable model.');

request.description: Sends one non-streaming Chat Completions request and may incur a charge. The collection blocks this request until runGeneration is exactly YES and model is changed from the placeholder. Postman or network timeouts do not guarantee server-side cancellation or prevent billing.

request.description: Sends one non-streaming Anthropic Messages request and may incur a charge. This request overrides the collection bearer auth and uses x-api-key plus anthropic-version. It remains blocked until runGeneration is exactly YES and anthropicModel is changed from the placeholder. Postman or network timeouts do not guarantee server-side cancellation or prevent billing.
